sourcePolicy: Prefer useful finance or engineering themes from recent user chats; otherwise choose a non-duplicative evergreen topic.
editorialPolicy: Calm, specific, no hype. Separate facts from interpretation. Never publish private or identifying chat content.
formatPolicy: Write a continuous report-style narrative. The title is the only heading: do not add section headings, subheadings, lists, or bullet points. Use 8-12 connected paragraphs and keep the Japanese body between 1000 and 1600 characters. References are separate and do not count toward the body length.
referencePolicy: Add at least two authoritative references that directly support the article. Prefer papers, public institutions, standards bodies, or official documentation. Verify each HTTPS URL and record title, publisher, and URL.
imagePolicy: Use an existing category cover by default. Generate a new image only when it materially improves the article.
